Grizzy finds himself back at square one and decides to find something to make holes in the walls and cheat. As for the Lemmings, they discover a magic map of the place that enables you to orient yourself and modify the corridors in real time. Which cheater will win?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Things start to disappear from the log cabin as if by magic. Grizzy is persuaded that the Lemmings are the culprits, but the Lemmings are also victims of inexplicable thefts. As they argue, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the true authors of the repeated thefts: a gang of fanatic partridges who bring stolen objects as offerings to their goddess, a giant partridge. Grizzy and Lemmings join forces to infiltrate the nest and recover their belongings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A frog swallows an ancestral jewel that bestows it with the power of mind control. Grizzy uses the frog to swallow the flies that have proliferated in the cabin, and which now let themselves be docilely caught. The Lemmings don’t miss a thing. They decide to get hold of the frog to hypnotize an uncooperative tapir who refuses to play rodeo. Grizzy hypnotizes the Lemmings, who become his servants. But several Lemmings escaped and are preparing a rescue mission.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A military convoy has an accident while transporting top-secret material. In the impact, a technological sphere flies out and rolls over to Grizzy, who was gathering berries in the forest. Grizzy realizes that the sphere is a sort of compass that indicates the direction of his desires. He follows it and finds a bush overflowing with his favorite berries. The Lemmings recover the compass to find super game sites in the forest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road. Paralysed with vertigo sixty feet up on a windowsill, he is eventually brought to earth by the helpful intervention of a neighbour’s pet gerbil.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: It might be Sunday, but Specs just won’t let up: his obsession with Lamput knows no weekends. Skinny, on the other hand, knows just how to spend his day off. Asleep, that’s how. Even if his workaholic buddy insists on dragging him through the usual pointless search. The call of a morning coffee wins the day, though; when Specs finally agrees to take a break, he discovers that even orange blobs like a sleep-in. And pancakes. Lots of pancakes.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Grundy, a giant monster truck, causes chaos as he stomps around Gotham and creates a mess. He’s too powerful for the Batwheels to stop, but Buff finds a friendly solution to end the city shaking shenanigans.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Batman calls on an old friend to lend MOE a hand in keeping the Batwheels clean and functional as they take on Condiment King.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Batman discusses the Batmobile's amazing capabilities and features during an interview at Gotham's auto show, featuring impressive clips of Bam in action as he swoops in to save the day.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Shaggy and Scooby discover their new favorite food as the gang investigates the mystery of a frightening Sorcerer that's haunting a snack factory!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang's trip to the bayou is ruined by a shambling Swamp Beast that's scaring away anyone who dares to enter its soggy domain!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are starving for their reserves are depleted and their fishing has been unsuccessful. Fortunately, a truck delivers a crate of edibles to the research station that contains compact food cubes. When placed under a special light beam, the cubes retransform into delicious meals. Grizzy discovers that the decompressing lamp can, conversely, compact organic elements too. For example, the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings pace around the log cabin searching for virtual animals to capture with their tablet game. Annoyed by their behavior, Grizzy throws them outside. Determined to continue playing, the Lemmings trick the bear. But when the tablet hits the circuit breaker and explodes, the gaming animals come to life! Ice dinosaurs, laser caribous and giant carnivorous plants. The life-size hunt can begin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A snowstorm rips the solar panels off the log cabin and Grizzy can no longer watch TV or enjoy the comforts of home! But he has a brilliant idea. He produces electricity by making a caribou run on a treadmill, using the last carrot in the house as bait. But the Lemmings absolutely want his carrot to make the perfect snowman.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings get their hands on a secret weapon that belongs to the Canadian Army: anyone hit with it becomes non-violent. They use the arm to transform Grizzy into a cherub, despite himself.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: When they discover a super fun app that allows you to see yourself as a rabbit or a robot or something else decked out with lots of animated accessories, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the tablet. But if they insist on arguing and refuse to share their virtual costumes, they could end up smashing each other's faces in for real.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: When they find an old book on traditional Japanese origami, the Lemmings churn out paper birds to play gliding games. Grizzy realizes that he could make the gorgeous butterfly on the cover for his beloved she-bear. But to make the Lemmings bow to his authority, he will first have to become a true origami master.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: When Lamput masquerades as a swimming trophy at the local pool, Skinny finds himself in his red trunks, warming up for the big race. You’d be surprised at how fast a Doc can swim when there’s a Lamput up for grabs. Skinny discovers skills not even he was aware of. Shame the trophies keep switching places. No lap-time in the world can outsmart this little orange blob.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Big Rex, the island's most feared predator, imprints on Miguel after being saved from a rockslide. Convinced he can train the mighty T-Rex to help around HQ, Miguel brings him home! But between broken equipment and a very terrified herd of dinos, it's clear that Big Rex doesn't belong in captivity! And worse, the raptor trio is running wild, wreaking havoc now that their boss is gone!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers spot a Mosasaurus, the ocean's mightiest predator! Min quickly realizes the mother Mosa has come here to give birth! After the baby is born, the exhausted mama drifts off to sleep. Min gives the newborn its first health check-up, but just as she finishes, the mother wakes! The enraged Mosa charges, triggering a rockslide that separates Min, Blitz, and the baby from the team!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to do something romantic on Valentine’s Day for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. But while he is secretly delivering her valentines card Mr Bean finds out he has a love rival for Irma’s attention. Bean steps up his efforts and takes Irma on a ‘date’ to the Valentine’s Fair only to find his love rival is there too! But will the fortune-teller’s prediction be the ticket to a happy ending?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean has forgotten he's supposed to be cooking dinner for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. He dashes to the supermarket to buy some groceries but why buy food when you can win an entire trolley full in an All You Can Eat Competition? But Mr Bean has some stiff competition - no one can eat one of Mr Magg’s pies quicker than Mr Maggs himself. Mr Bean has to think fast to win. But after all that eating will Bean still be in the mood to cook a romantic meal?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in need of a sturdy new bookcase and sets off to visit a furniture warehouse. He finds one that’s perfect but is outraged when he’s told he has to build the bookcase himself! Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase failing miserably when he discovers he’s one screw short. Mr Bean heads back to the shop only to find it’s closed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: As Mr Bean settles down to watch his favourite TV programme he hears loud noises from next-door. He moves from house to garden but can’t escape the relentless cacophony of trumpets, electric drills, and screaming babies. Bean’s mind turns to thoughts of revenge….

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Beaver has set himself the task of building the tallest tower possible. Unfortunately, it's dark before he can finish, but he's not going to stop, despite the difficulties of building in the dark. As for the Baby Lemmings, they're enjoying the spectacle of shooting stars when suddenly one of them crashes not far from them! A pretty, shiny, luminous stone. They decide to send it back up into the sky with the other stars. But Baby Beaver would love this luminous stone, which would enable him to continue his work even in the dark.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: With Baby Owl bored to tears, the Baby Lemmings have invented a new game: figurines made from acorns. With them, they create a kind of small village in their own playmobile style. Baby Owl would like to play with them, but clumsily destroys the whole village. Thinking she's done it on purpose, the Baby Lemmings run away from her in the hope of being able to play in peace.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Seeing a line of ants carrying leaves and flowers gives a group of baby lemmings the idea of doing a choreography to imitate them. Seeing that their baby lemming friends like it, they decide to put on a little show. Baby Lynx discovers this and, a little jealous, decides to crash the show and put herself forward. Clumsily, she unwittingly puts an end to the show. While the baby lemmings are looking for a quiet place to do their show again, Baby Lynx decides to put on a show of her own to steal the show.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs' peace and tranquility is interrupted when Yosemite Sam mines his home for coal.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks are going on week three of being snowed in when they discover the last bit of food in the house. Let the battle begin!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks take a trip to the Grand Canyon only to have their travels sidelined by a run-in with the Barbarian.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: The dim hunters believe Bigfoot is a giant rabbit and hunt him. Bugs just wants to be left alone but keeps getting involved.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is serving food at a diner. Jerry and Tuffy sneak in and eat the food. Tom tries to chase them out of the diner and in the end they all share a delicious treat.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: he gang head out to a Day of the Dead festival. There, they learn the spirit of the old, legendary criminal, El Bandito, has returned to terrorize the locals. Fred becomes obsessed with solving the mystery and becoming a part of the great legend, himself.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Daphne agrees to watch her friend's kid, Wayne, and convinces Fred to take a night off from mysteries to go to the boardwalk amusement park. Unbeknownst to her, though, the park is being haunted by a fiendish clown, Madcap.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean breaks his favourite Royal mug he discovers there's only one place to buy a replacement: Buckingham Palace, home of the Queen of England. When one of Her Majesty's corgis runs off with his teddy, Bean gives chase through secret tunnels… and gets lost.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his local bakery to buy a cake but finds he doesn’t have any money. He goes to the bank to use the cash machine but he can’t remember his pin number. When Mr Bean's bankcard is swallowed up by the cash machine there’s only one thing to do - go into the machine and fetch it back. The police are alerted but Bean’s main concern is to get some money and get back to the baker’s before all the cakes are sold.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: After catching a crook, Tom and Jerry are framed, and the police chase them instead of the true criminal. Tom and Jerry must go on the lam as they try to avoid jail time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Because of an injured foot, Rick stays home with Ginger's mother, Rosemary, taking care of him. Rosemary brings her infamous fat-free-dairy-free whole wheat gravy, and she quickly puts Rick, Spike and Tom on nutritious diets. Antics and fights break out as Rick and the pets crave real food.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry take a case for Toodles' cousin in Hawaii, hoping to sneak in some rest and relaxation, but it's no vacation. The cousin's missing pineapple plant is only the starting place of the investigation as Tom and Jerry track down the culprit in this tropical environment.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy's TV remote control is stolen by a partridge who collects high-tech objects in his nest perched high up in a tree. This is a case of absolute urgency! Grizzy has no other choice but to requisition the Lemmings propulsion game to recover his possession. But try and make a Lemming understand that!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy has got it into his head to offer a butterfly to the she-bear he's in love with. But the Lemmings fight with him over the rare specimens he's spotted, for they want to play helicopter. The butterfly hunt is on!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have discovered an addictive new game based on the astonishing bouncing properties of the ranger's new running shoes. Grizzy, who is trying to relax, confiscates the shoes and soon realizes they are far more comfortable than his thongs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy babysits for the she-bear he has a crush on, who has entrusted him with the care of her cub. There's no question of Grizzy tripping up, for he has no intention of taking any risks! But he hadn't reckoned on the Lemmings. Captivated by the baby's burps after meals, they dream of making it drink gallons of soda pop to make it do the Big One.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Unwilling to share the food both he and the Lemmings are wild about, Grizzy locks it up inside the ranger’s brand new and apparently burglar proof safe. He watches the Lemmings’ vain attempts to open the safe with amusement, until he realizes that the string around his neck with the key is far from indestructible.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is impressed by the TV show of a magician who transforms a partridge into a bouquet of flowers. To get rid of the Lemmings once and for all, for they exasperate him with their incessant games, Grizzy tries the magic trick on them. And apparently... it works!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kid Kazoom and Multy are sent to train with a Legendary SuperThing, Lancelord.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Bibi and Batgirl team up with the fabulous magician of the Justice League, Zatana, and her amazing magic-using car, Presto!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar...

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with some help from Ace!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Batman gets help from a mysterious, yet somehow familiar hero as he chases the villain Croc through the tunnels beneath Gotham City.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: While on vacation, The Looney Builders befriend Coco the Crab and offer to build her a mini-resort. They shrink down for a micro-build and must rely on the island’s natural resources to get the job done.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Mac Gopher to build a hot air balloon for him and Tosh to ride in for a festival. Tosh keeps his fear of flying to himself and tries to weigh down the build to avoid liftoff.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Yosemite Sam to build a dude ranch. Sam hurries the crew along, negatively impacting their work.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build a baseball field, but both Bugs and Lola want to be the pitcher for the big game later. They attempt to prove themselves as they work, causing setbacks with the build.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: A music video of Lola Bunny using her bulldozer to move things as she oversees various looney builds.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is frustrated: just as he was about to coat a nice big fresh salmon with chocolate spread and snuggle up in front of the TV, he discovers that the pantry is empty! His frustration transforms into rage when he finds the last jar in the clutches of the Lemmings, who are organizing a sort of beach party in the sandbox.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy's nap is interrupted by an annoying vibrating. He sees the forest ranger's cell phone on the couch. It has various functions, including a game to which he instantly becomes addicted. However the Lemmings, who have already detected the phone's music app, need it in order to transform the garage into a discotheque.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Freed by the thawing ice, a mysterious giant egg slides up to the front door of the log cabin. The Lemmings watch the hatching of a large baby dinosaur that immediately mistakes them for his mommies. Grizzy cannot tolerate a new intruder like this in the cabin, but how does one earn the respect of a gang of Lemmings armed with a T-Rex, even it is only a baby?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: In order to seduce the she-bear he's infatuated with, Grizzy decides to take things in hand and slim down with the ranger's bodybuilding equipment. But before starting his exercise routine, he will first have to settle the problem of the Lemmings, who are already using the machines as an amusement park.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: By chance, Grizzy discovers that the ranger's new robot vacuum cleaner also gives very pleasant back massages. But the Lemmings see the new gadget more as a competition bumper car. No one wants to do the housecleaning, but everyone wants the robot vacuum cleaner!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While searching for the television remote control, Grizzy discovers a gadget that controls various functions in the cabin. Hup! One button and there's light! Hup! Another surveys the house's nooks and crannies. Grizzy will finally be able to rid himself of the Lemmings, without even leaving the couch! But beware of losing control...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: To make sure that the Lemmings don't snatch his chocolate spread while he's taking his nap, Grizzy turns the fridge into a safe - combination lock and all. The Lemmings try in vain to break into the fridge until they see Grizzy open the door while sleepwalking. Unfortunately, Grizzy wakes up at the crucial moment. The Lemmings do everything possible to make him fall back asleep as quick as possible.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have invented a new popcorn game which consists of throwing popcorn and catching it with their mouths. Grizzy notices that his lovely she-bear seems to be drawn by the scent of the grilled corn and decides to invite her over for a snack, just the two of them. But first, he must quickly recover the popcorn from the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to learn to dance the mambo to please the she-bear he's in love with, for she truly adores this rhythm. He finds a learning kit at the ranger's home which has a dance carpet with footprints that light up in rhythm. The only problem is that Lemmings want the ghetto-blaster to continue their rave party to an entirely different beat.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: After receiving a terrible blow over the head, Grizzy is no longer the same: he thinks he's a rodent! He tries to get the gang to adopt him so that he might participate in their fun and games like any other Lemming. But it's not long before his newfound comrades start to find him rather heavy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is exhausted and the couch has never seemed so enticing! He goes to fetch a pillow and a sleeping mask, but the Lemmings have entirely different plans for the couch. They see it as a fabulous trampoline and the ideal spot for an aerobics session. To win the right to have his nap, the weary bear must first contend with the super-energetic Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers that the frenzied break dance the Lemmings are doing is actually due to the fleas they are infested with. When Grizzy catches them too, it's panic all round! Grizzy is determined to eliminate the parasites, down to the very last one. The problem is his little roommates have no desire whatsoever to be treated...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Another heat wave: even the riverbed is dried up. One very thirsty Grizzy discovers that the Lemmings have used the last remaining bottles of water to fill their inflatable pool. He has no intention of letting the Lemmings swim in what might very well be his last chance to quench his thirst.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have caught a little spider. Her sticky, elastic threads are absolutely perfect for bungee jumping. Grizzy, who has no intention of getting caught in the web, decides to crush the insect. The only problem: he discovers that he has arachnophobia, which is seriously going to complicate the task.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over chocolate-spread jar lids, which they use as chips in a competition to win goodies. Indeed, next to the supermarket are two jackpot-style machines with slots the size of the lids. But more importantly, there's a key to be won that makes you eligible for the grand prize... the giant jar of Yummy on display under a glass cover.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: “Chasing Lamput” turns out to be the ultimate backstage pass; the Docs pursue the orange blob through the dressing room and directly onto the stage of a gigantic stadium rock concert. The crowd goes wild. Which raises questions about their taste in music, to be honest; Skinny plays guitar like he’s gotten himself tangled in the strings (which he has), and Specs’ drumming, well, it’s certainly got passion. No taste, skill or rhythm, but certainly passion. The stage ends up in tatters by the time the actual band arrives. Those Docs are a hard act to follow.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Moley helps take care of the worms at Dotty’s Adopt a Worm Rescue Center, the Gardener sends Squirm to pose as a homeless worm and help him steal Manny.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley vows to not eat worms for a few days in support of Dotty’s veganism and his worm craving temptations get out of control.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Moley spends the day with a young mole named Cheese who wants to be just like him, Moley helps Cheese recognize his own talents and uniqueness.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mishmosh builds a tunnel digger, upsetting some that it will replace moles’ need to dig themselves. Dotty accidently gets locked in the machine and it gets activated!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Buttercup (the Queen’s dog) digs his way down into Moletown, he forms a bond with the Gardener.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: In this country-inspired music video, Buff the Bat-Truck shows off his strength as he tows the bad guys out of town and lifts the spirits of his fellow Batwheels with his sensitive side, all while protecting the people (and critters) of Gotham.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Chep discovers he is great at giving snails massages. But the Food and Travel Snails now want massages all the time. Exhausting! Chep has to learn how to tell them NO!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Mush-Mush goes on an adventure with Morel and Sushi-Mushi. He worries he won’t be cool enough to fit in with the older Mushables, so makes Chep come along for support.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Lilit loves dancing. The only Mushable she hasn’t danced with is Amanita. But Amanita doesn’t dance. Can Lilit get her dancing?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Miff has a blast playing a game with our Mushlers – one that Fung refused to play. Now Fung worries that he has lost his best friend and so tries to win her back.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: To prove to everyone that he does not make cooking mistakes, Sushi-Mushi revisits his chef training. But what he really needs training in, is admitting mistakes!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: The Kazoom Kids must choose their hero name as they take on Cerealiak with the help of Mighty Moo.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Kept awake by Tom watching TV, Jerry goes outside and encounters some lightning bugs. The smallest one can't keep up, so Jerry steals Tom's energy drink for the little guy. It helps, but soon the super-charged bug causes unexpected issues for Tom and Jerry.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Skullie warns Tom that it's almost midnight, so he'd best be on alert for one of the Catsylvania ghouls to show up. Tom reaches for a towel to wipe the soap out of his eyes but is shocked to discover that he's not using a towel at all, but a Mummy-cat's wrap! Soon, the Mummy-cat finds ways to freak out Tom and befuddle him, Jerry and Tuffy all over the house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Hoping to woo Toodles, Tom decides to make some homemade perfume for her. He throws in many unusual ingredients and gets a surprisingly pleasant outcome, getting the attention he craved. However, soon Tom and Jerry must come up with a plan when the heavenly scent turns bad.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Tom and Butch both arrive to ask out Toodles, their competitive behavior prompts her to send them away to a charm school she recently attended. But how will they fare in the grueling etiquette courses taught by elegant cat instructors?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Things go awry when Cates orders Tom to clean and inspect the family automobile. Tom, Jerry and Tuffy end up taking the car into the countryside and doing their best to control it. As Tom reads and attempts to follow the instruction manual, Jerry and Tuffy help, but they also suffer many near-misses.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy is about to start eating the last remaining food in the cabin: cocktail snacks. But the sly Lemmings get there first. A fight breaks out but is quickly cut short by the unexpected visit of a wart hog. The pig devours the crackers and then, using his snout, detects a forgotten old package of candy under the bed, which he also proceeds to gobble down. Everyone realizes that the creature has the ability to find food. Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over who will follow the beast to track down food.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In order to win a trophy filled with Yummy candies, Grizzy and the Lemmings take part in a safari photo competition on an animal reserve. They must capture the portraits of a number of wild animals that live in the park. It requires all their cunning to approach the elephant, wart hog and bat and take photos for the contest. But when it comes to the super-speedy, blue-necked ostrich, it's a different kettle of fish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While Grizzy organizes a picnic alongside the pond, the Lemmings steal his jar of Yummy using water balls to discreetly advance underwater. Despite their equipment, the bear surprises the Lemmings and traps the rodents inside a waterproof ball which he throws far into the distance. An ostrich mistakes the ball for her egg and sits on it, waiting for the egg to hatch. The Lemmings are adopted by this new mother who is prepared to do anything to satisfy her offspring!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Big Rex, the island's most feared predator, imprints on Miguel after being saved from a rockslide. Convinced he can train the mighty T-Rex to help around HQ, Miguel brings him home! But between broken equipment and a very terrified herd of dinos, it's clear that Big Rex doesn't belong in captivity! And worse, the raptor trio is running wild, wreaking havoc now that their boss is gone!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers spot a Mosasaurus, the ocean's mightiest predator! Min quickly realizes the mother Mosa has come here to give birth! After the baby is born, the exhausted mama drifts off to sleep. Min gives the newborn its first health check-up, but just as she finishes, the mother wakes! The enraged Mosa charges, triggering a rockslide that separates Min, Blitz, and the baby from the team!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: An old photo album causes Bean to reminisce about his lovely summers at scout camp as a boy, and sets him planning a night under the stars with Teddy. Purchasing a tent becomes a tricky problem – but nothing will stop him having a good time, even if he has to get the garden shed over the roof of his house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When his model aeroplane is blown out of the sky by that of a rival kid, Mr. Bean sets his sights on revenge. Next day, his newly constructed fighter plane, almost ready for take-off, sadly lacks a vital part – and the blinking model shop is shut! No matter. It’s chocks away with Teddy at the controls, fighting for airspace over London N10.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose is dismayed by the recklessness of the Baby Lemmings, who wander through the forest oblivious to the dangers around them. Exhausted by having to save them from small dangers, he decides instead to teach them the rudiments of safety and equip them with protective gear. But the Baby Lemmings aren't too keen on this.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover that bouncing on mushrooms makes a bass drum sound. The rhythmic sound makes Baby Lynx want to dance. Seeing her, the baby lemmings discover the joys of dancing and dance with her. But Baby Lynx wants to remain the center of attention and prevents the lemmings from dancing. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings discover a cave with a crystal on the ceiling that turns into a sort of disco ball, creating a real dance hall where they'd rather Baby Lynx didn't come.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby chipmunk has a collection of pretty gems. But when she loses a round one and it rolls past the Baby lemmings, they get the idea of organising a marble run. They collect lots of objects, cut them to make them spherical and... And off they go! But when the Baby chipmunk realises she's lost her stone, she wants it back. And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back! But the baby lemmings have no intention of stopping their mad marble race through the forest!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: On Halloween Night, Poison Ivy brings all the pumpkins to life, creating an army of Snack-O-Lanterns that are eating all the candy. It’s up to Redbird and Bam to end her pumpkin panic to save Gotham’s Halloween fun, as well as their own.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean and his beloved car find themselves in a crash for crash battle with his arch nemesis the Reliant Robin. It’s a contest to find out who can hold their nerve the longest. Does Mr Bean win? Is his car left unscathed? And more importantly do we find out who the driver of the Reliant Robin really is?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is over the moon when he meets Mr. Pod because both men have so much in common; same shirt, jacket, trousers and underpants. And to top it all, Pod is Bean’s spitting image! Bean falls to Earth with a bump, though, when his girlfriend, Irma Gobb, finds Mr. Pod much better looking than him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Scooby runs into an old kennel mate Axel who is a highly trained Police dog who thinks mystery of the Junk yard monster is too big a case for the gang.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: When a video game company tries to buy an old algorithm from Velma and convince her to work for them in San Francisco, the gang becomes embroiled in the mystery of a video game villain who has seemingly come to life, the Ghost Chef.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a hand-shaped scepter ornated with a gold nugget that covers anything it touches with gold. Grizzy uses the object to “gold leaf” the Lemmings and swipe their chocolate bar. The Lemmings use their golden casts as armors to recover their chocolate. During the combat, the gold nugget is replaced by a chocolate one: the scepter now coats everything with chocolate. The Lemmings snatch it and flee.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize a dance contest where the first prize is a jar of chocolate spread. Grizzy is hungry and decides to participate. He partners up with a talented dancing parrot and wins. Incapable of sharing, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the prize. The parrot brings the jar to a temple devoted to the glory of dancing parrots. To get it back, Grizzy and the Lemmings must perform a choreography. They decide to rehearse together.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange creature fossilized in amber resin that resembles him. A natural science encyclopedia confirms that it’s his ancestor. Grizzy wants to take the block of amber, but the Lemmings fight him for it because the blue animal with big teeth is their ancestor too. The block cracks during their fight and frees the ancestor who turns out to be a rather unmanageable burden.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a strange card game representing the elements along with instructions. The idea is to pretend that the ground is on fire or of ice, like in the game “Floor is Lava.” They transform the cabin into a giant adventure trail. Depending on the card drawn, they must avoid zones on the floor with flames or wax. Grizzy unceremoniously gets rids of the setup to regain control of the cabin. One of the cards lands on a stone slab that transforms into lava. The Lemmings are delighted: they will be able to play “for real”!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a very particular cocoa tree with chocolate-spread sap! Reduced to eating canned Brussels sprouts, the only remaining food in the cabin, Grizzy is baffled when he sees the Lemmings parading past to equip themselves with all sorts of containers: ladles, soup spoons, bowls, buckets, basins, etc. He watches them through binoculars and discovers that they have planted a faucet in a tree where chocolate spread flows. Grizzy decides to siphon off their tree.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy expels the Lemmings from the cabin where they had built a cumbersome obstacle course. Peaceful at last and feeling lazy, he is determined not to leave his couch. The Lemmings discover a magic Mayan disc that allows you to choose instantaneous mutations of other animals’ features: bat wings, reindeer antlers, elephant trunks, etc. The mutant Lemmings return to the cabin, determined to continue playing their game while enjoying their new accessories.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell - and embarks on a hilarious mission to pull out this menace. Bean’s DIY attempts fail to succeed, and he is left with no other choice but to visit the dreaded dentist. But can Bean brave the Dentist’s chair? Or will the dentist despair when faced with Bean’s antics?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput faints of thirst on a desert highway, so already it’s not a great day for the little orange shape-shifter. Add to that the fact that Specs and Skinny just happen by in a lockup van, and things go south pretty promptly. Specs and Skinny learn a valuable lesson: maybe if you’re going to anger a morphing super-blob by throwing them in the back of a van and withholding precious water, you shouldn’t do it whilst driving by a 100 foot cliff drop down to the open ocean. Hopefully these Docs are better swimmers than your average academic.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Bam gushes over his personal hero and idol - Batman! During an ongoing mission, Bam awes at all the cool moves and awesome antics that Batman shows off. Potentially can be done with existing footage.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang hits the ski slopes, although Daphne's more focused on nailing Fred with a revenge snowball. Their snowy fun is soon interrupted by the appearance of an evil Snowman Monster eager to scare all trespassers off his mountain.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve and Fred is ready to solve a Christmas mystery! Unfortunately, the gang has arrived in a town that's being attacked by a Pterodactyl and it doesn't seem to have anything to do with Christmas!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers in shock that the TV has been replaced with a trompe-l’oeil image. Furious, he flushes the Lemmings out of their hiding place where they’d hoped to watch their favorite cartoon in peace and propels them as far as possible. They land in an ancient cave where a powerful spirit capable of entering individuals is asleep. The Lemmings decide to free the spirit and send it to Grizzy. But will they be able to control the spirit?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Not easy to enjoy a DVD about salmon when the Lemmings are having a disco party right there. Grizzy sends them packing with such force that they land at the research station, where they discover a state-of-the-art U.V. cabin. When turned up to the max, the light therapy and music options can advantageously replace the disco equipment Grizzy destroyed. The noise they make causes a block of ice to break off. It hurdles down the slope to the cabin and destroys Grizzy’s TV. But it doesn’t take the bear long to figure out that the U.V. cabin also has a DVD function.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun destroying ice towers. When Grizzy sees them, it inspires him to sculpt statues of himself. The Lemmings cannot resist the temptation to destroy the statues of Grizzy, who does everything in his power to protect them.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are all lined up on the couch to watch a cartoon film where a mouse plays nasty tricks on a cat. Grizzy, who has decided to take his nap, switches off the TV and confiscates the batteries of the remote control to make sure they can't switch their program back on. But is it wise to frustrate a gang of Lemmings who've been inspired by a gag-filled cartoon?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Once again, Grizzy shows the Lemmings that they just don't measure up to him physically and that the last jar of chocolate spread is for the strongest. The Lemmings find a way around this by increasing the power of a lamp that accelerates plant growth and instantly expand themselves to... bear size.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay their hands on a full crate of chocolate spread, which they hide somewhere behind Grizzy's back. And since the Lemmings are both prudent and cunning, it's impossible to surprise them when they pay a visit to their secret hoard. Until the day Grizzy discovers a magic ring that enables him to take on the appearance of a Lemming.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. Lamput learns an important lesson from a nearby blobby little girl. Be yourself, and if anyone's got a problem with that, they can go find their own patch of sand.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers glide through the kelp forest, gathering fresh sea greens! Above them, the Tinhorns float in their family air balloon, tossing trash overboard and polluting the ocean! Peace turns to panic when Thunderfin, the island's massive Mosasaur, surges toward the Jetter! The Ranchers race to escape as the creature slams into the sub, but his movements aren't just angry, they're pained!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers are trying to wrangle a stubborn triceratops with a log jammed on her horn! Watching from the sidelines, Clara Tinhorn finds herself strangely charmed by the feisty creature, while Atticus has his eye on something shinier: the Ranchers' Jungle Jetter! Later that night, under cover of darkness; Clara, Atticus and their new dino friend sneak into the HQ with plans to snag the vehicle.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside. But when he arrives at his hotel a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all for herself. And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to find a nice quiet place to read his book so he sets off for the Library. But instead of reading he becomes distracted by some funny online videos he sees on the Library’s computer. Before he knows it Mr Bean is recording his own video which is uploaded for everyone to see. Things start to go crazy when people check out his funny video and his popularity takes off. But does Mr Bean enjoy being in the public eye and how long will his celebrity last?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Envious of all the attention his landlady is receiving because of a broken leg, Mr. Bean decides to 'break' his leg too. When he ends up in hospital under the care of the Matron from Hell he discovers there are some kinds of attention even he doesn't enjoy.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings become friends and play with crickets. Baby Moose hates these bugs, which terrify him. Baby Moose hides to avoid running into the insects, but he comes face to face with a cricket that has been thrown off while playing with the lemmings. Panic-stricken, Baby Moose tries to put these threatening pests out of action, but after a blunder he finds himself adrift on the water with a cricket!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: It's been raining a lot these last few days! That's why the Baby Lemmings are discovering little croaking frogs! They're so much fun! Baby Chipmunk is having great difficulty climbing trees made slippery by the rain to reach her nuts. Seeing the frogs' long tongues, she decides to “borrow” them to make her job easier.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover a fun new game: running on logs! While playing, the Baby lemmings find themselves racing Baby Lynx without realizing it. To the horror of Baby Lynx, who hates defeat, she loses the race! The Baby Lemmings with their logs are faster than Baby Lynx. Her pride stung, she decides to steal the vehicle that allows her to be faster.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs wants to be the first to ride a new mega roller coaster and finds himself lucky to be front and center with Porky Pig.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs attempts to help Dr. Clovenhoof become the Superhero he's always dreamed of becoming.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Yosemite Sam fight over the last hot toy of the holiday season.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: When Squeaks mistakes the Barbarian for Santa Claus Bugs has to intervene in order to retrieve his Holiday Wish List.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang goes on a camping trip, although they can't really agree on why. Fred's desire for the gang to get in touch with their natural instincts and hones their mystery skills, turns into on-the-job training as Viking Ghosts attack and attempt to drive them away – or worse.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Fred is on trial, convicted of being the real mastermind behind all the mysteries he's solved. With the help of his defense attorney, Daphne, we go back over the day's events at a town that had been abandoned since the 1950's because of a toxic chemical spill where a Toxic Mutant has been terrorizing all who dare go near the town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When did Mr. Bean first meet his teddy bear? Did he really learn to drive his mini at the age of ten? Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride? Bean takes us on a journey into the past, answering these questions and giving us an inkling as to what made him the man he is today.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is furious with the untidy state of the streets and all the people who drop litter so he goes on a one-man mission to clean up the town. Armed with several bin bags Mr Bean collects all the rubbish and puts up his own ‘No Littering’ signs - which have absolutely no effect. When the police show no interest in his campaign Bean builds a homemade vacuuming contraption causing chaos and mayhem wherever he goes.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom is chasing the mice around the haunted house when midnight strikes, and he finds himself face-to-face with a green-faced beast who's just as surprised to encounter Tom. It's soon revealed to be Toodles, who's a good witch brewing magic beauty products. Although Tom is enchanted at first, things stop going smoothly when he helps with her potions.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: After entering Tyke in an agility contest, Spike sets up a course for the puppy in the backyard. Soon, Spike decides the course isn't hard enough and gets Tom to help, bending Tom into pretzel-like positions for Tyke to leap over, through, or into. After all this preparation, Tyke must still make it to the competition on time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry take a case from a mother tortoise to find out where her son Seymour is sneaking off to at night. They discover Seymour is self-training to win a championship boxing match, planning to pay off bills with the prize money so his mom can quit the car wash. When he offers Tom and Jerry a cut of the money to keep his secret, they take it and agree to train him—but it won't be easy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers a baby raccoon not far from the log cabin. When he sees its big moist eyes, Grizzy melts and adopts the creature. When the Lemmings drag the baby into their dangerous games, the overprotective Grizzy steps in, provoking even more perilous situations!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When a meteorite falls not far from the log cabin, strange berries start to grow. One of their properties is that they make anyone who eats them grow to disproportionate sizes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When he brandishes a native american scepter that the Lemmings brought home with other antique objects, Grizzy sees the Lemmings bow low before him and behave like servants. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy tries to impress the she-bear that he's in love with by making a sculpture of her from a piece of wood. Grizzy must succeed in getting rid of the Lemmings without his model realizing what's going on. An Art in itself!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings throw a surprise birthday party for one of the clan. From that point on, Grizzy has only one objective: stop the din, which is not at all helping his migraine headache. But for the Lemmings, the party must go on at any price.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Pripažinkit mane kaltu
programme.desc: Tikrais įvykiais paremtas filmas apie vieną didžiausių teismų JAV. Plėšikėlį Džiakomą Dinorsčio pašauna jo pusbrolis Tonis, bet Džiakomas neketina reikšti jam pretenzijų. O netrukus Dinorsčio vėl atsiduria policijos akiratyje ir už narkotikus nuteisiamas trylika metų kalėti. Ryžtingas advokatas Šonas Kirnis pasiryžęs kalėjimam susodinti visą Italijos mafiją, daugelį Džiakomo draugų ir giminaičių. Jo pusbrolis Tonis iškart sutinka teisėsaugai talkinti. Bet liudyti prieš savus – ne Džiakomo būdui. Jis paprašo teisėjo leisti jam gintis pačiam, be jokio advokato. Jo vulgari gynyba kartais prajuokina prisiekusiuosius ir užpykdo teisėją bei kitus liudytojus. Teismo procesas išsitęsia iki kelių mėnesių, pritraukia daug dėmesio. Filmą režisavo penkiems Oskarams nominuotas, o 2005 metais už ilgametę kūrybą Garbės Oskaru apdovanotas režisierius Sidney Lumet.

programme.title: Mes nusipirkome zoologijos sodą
programme.desc: Garsūs aktoriai Mattas Damonas ir Scarlett Johansson ėmėsi neįprasto amplua ir sutiko vaidinti filme, skirtame visai šeimai. Tai šilta tikrais faktais paremta istorija apie žmoną praradusį Bendžaminą, kuris, norėdamas pradėti gyvenimą iš naujo, įsigyja namą su zoologijos sodu. Naujas pirkinys labai patinka jo dukrelei Rouzei, tačiau visai nežavi paauglio sūnaus Dilano, kuris visai nenori palikti mieste draugų ir pomėgių. Zoologijos sodui labai reikia renovacijos, tad Bendžaminas kartu su sodo vadove Kele imasi remonto darbų ir, deja, netrukus įklimpsta į finansines bėdas. Darbuotojai turi pasistengti, kad grąžintų žvėrynui senąją šlovę, vėl pritrauktų lankytojus... bei atlaikytų svarbų veterinarų patikrinimą. Filmą, remdamasis tikrais faktais, sukūrė Oskaru apdovanotas režisierius Cameronas Crowe. Tikrovėje zoologijos sodą įsigyti buvo kur kas sunkiau nei filme – tai užtruko net dvejus metus, be to, tikrasis Bedžaminas Mee jį įsigijo ne Amerikoje, kaip rodoma filme, o Didžiojoje Britanijoje.

programme.desc: Srovių karas

programme.title: 9 kulkos
programme.desc: Ilgus metus šokusi erotinius šokius, Čigonė nutaria užverti nuodėmėse skęstantį gyvenimo puslapį ir pradėti gyvenimą iš naujo. Moteris parašo savo atsiminimų knygą ir pasirašo sutartį su leidėju. Deja, likimas siunčia rimtą moralinį išbandymą. Ji privalo apsispręsti, - išgelbėti mažą berniuką Semą, kurio visa šeima tapo nusikaltėlių grupuotės aukomis, ar palikti berniuką siaubingame pavojuje. Čigonė nutaria nuvežti vaiką į saugią vietą, pas jo dėdę į Pietų Dakotą. Kelionėje jiems ant kulnų lipa kraujo trokštantys smogikai, kurie negali palikti Semo gyvo. Juk jis – vienintelis savo šeimos žudynių liudininkas. Jis turi nutilti amžiams. Ar Čigonei pavyks pasprukti nuo nusikaltėlių ir apsaugoti vaiką?

Negana to, ji sužino, kad paveldėjo salą, kurioje praleido laimingiausias vaikystės dienas. Maja kategoriškai nesutinka priimti palikimo. Ji ketina atsisakyti salos. Tik ilgų įtikinėjimų dėka, jos dragas Piteris įtikina ją paskutinį kartą aplankyti salą. Nuvykusi į salą ji sutinka vaikystės draugus ir jų tetą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Mėnulio princesė
programme.desc: Kai 13-metės Marijos Meriveter tėtis miršta, palikdamas ją našlaite ir bename, jai tenka palikti prabangų gyvenimą Londone ir vykti gyventi su ekscentrišku dėde Bendžaminu paslaptinguose Mėnulio slėnio rūmuose. Greitai Marija atsiduria griūvančiame mėnulio nutviekstame pasaulyje, kurį drasko ilgalaikė nesantaika su tamsia ir grėsminga De Nuarų šeima. Marija sužino, kad ji yra paskutinioji Mėnulio princesė. Padedama neįtikėtinų sąjungininkų, ji turi nugalėti savo šeimos išdidumą, kad išsiaiškintų praeities paslaptis iki tol, kol 5000-ąjį kartą patekės mėnulis ir Mėnulio slėnis amžiams nugrims į jūrą.

programme.title: Angelas sargas
programme.desc: Šivradžas ir Rasal – vienas kitą mylintys brolis ir sesuo. Netekę mylimos mamos, vaikai užgauliojami bendraamžių ir engiami kaimynų. Brolis jaučia didelę atsakomybę apsaugoti mažąją sesutę, tad tampa tikru apsaugos skydu kasdieniuose iššūkiuose. Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. Ar meilė ir ištikimybė padės išlikti kartu klastinguose gyvenimo posūkiuose? Ar blogo linkintys niekšai palauš vaikų pasitikėjimą vienas kitu?

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Svajonių laivas. Laplandija
programme.desc: Kapitonas Maksas Pargeris nukreipia svajonių laidą link Laplandijos krantų. Bet čia jo laukia staigmena, nes seni mokyklos draugai Patrikas ir Maikas padaro Maksui staigmeną ir kviečia į nuotykių kupiną pažintį su atšiauria šalimi. Vyrukai leidžiasi į kelionę šunų kinkiniais. Bet įvyksta nelaimė ir vyrai lieka be ryšio priemonių nežinomose platybėse. Tamsa ir šaltis baugina, bet Maksas nutaria eiti ieškoti pagalbos.Laivu plaukia ir sunkiai serganti šešiolikmetė Katia. Be tėvo auganti mergina jaučia didelę mamos meile ir rūpestį. Tačiau vaistai, kuriuos vartoja mergaitė, akivaizdžiai neturi teigiamo poveikio jos savijautai. Laivo gydytoja Džsesika Delgado pasiūlo mergaitei pakeisti vaistus, bet jos mama prieštarauja ir sako, kad dukros gydytojų sprendimu pasitiki ir neketina jiems prieštarauti. Vis tik Katia pradeda slėpti vaistus nuo mamos ir jos sveikata akyse gerėja. Kokie įtarimai užgrius Lizą? Gal ji nesąmoningai siekia pakenkti dukrai?Restorano vadovas Benas vyksta į kelionę su savo nauja simpatija – Karolina Jensen. Benas ypatingai pasistengė ir išnuomojo sau ir Karolinai sniego motociklą, suorganizavo nakvynę ledo viešbutyje. Vyras nuveža Karoliną prie rąstinio namelio. Čia jis svajoja atidaryti restoranėlį, kuriam vadovautų drauge su Karolina. Ar mergina ryšis palikti seną gyvenimą ir pradėti naują čia – Laplandijoje?

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus, skamba gyvo garso pasirodymai, laidos svečiai atlieka netikėčiausias užduotis.

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: „Moterų laimės“ pirmasis sezonas pasakojo apie buvusią namų šeimininkę, vienišą mamą ir tris jaunas, nepatyrusias merginas, kurios ėmėsi bendro verslo ir dėl to nuolat kovojo su gyvenimo negandomis. Šią vasarą „Moterų laimės“ pagrindinė istorija suksis apie vieną heroję – aštuoniolikmetę Mildą, užaugusią vaikų namuose ir netikėtai atsidūrusią sostinėje. Milda – drąsi, nebijanti pakovoti už save, tačiau gyvenimas Vilniuje bus visai ne toks, kokio ji tikėjosi. Čia jos lauks susitikimas su biologine mama, nelegalus darbas... Herojė ne savo noru įsivels į kriminalinę veiklą, o šis jos biografijos šešėlis tikrai nepadės ateityje – nei karjeroje, nei meilėje. Į šią istoriją įsivels ne tik jaunas perspektyvus verslininkas, bet ir pagiežingas, herojei į tėvus tinkantis vyras. Tiesa, jų tikslai bus labai skirtingi...

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.

Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Baterijos nepridedamos
programme.desc: Kai Niujorko didmiestyje, Manheteno rajone, buvo nuspręsta pastatyti milžinišką visuomeninį centrą, statybininkai ėmėsi griauti visus trukdančius naujajam projektui namus. Vieno namo gyventojai išdrįso pasipriešinti ir susilaukė ištisos lavinos grasinimų ir žiaurausio smurto. Juos išgelbėti galėjo nebent ateiviai. Ir nuostabiausia, kad staiga danguje pasirodė nedidukės skraidančios lėkštutės...

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.desc: Laivo kapitonas Maksas laivą kreipia į Kokosų salas. Ši kelionė – tikra staigmena Pargerio kolegoms. Juk vienas geriausių Makso draugų vadovauja Kokosų saloje esančiam restoranui ir ketina paruošti tikrą puotą. Įgulos kapitonas Martinas Grimas ir laivo gydytoja Delgado džiugiai priima kvietimą, bet Hana atsisako. Tik personalui vadovaujantis Martinas Grimas įtarią tikrąją atsisakymo priežastį. Jis paprašo persvarstyti savo sprendimą ir eiti vakarieniauti drauge. Ar Hanos sprendimas nepakenks moters karjerai? Kodėl ji atsisakė priimti kapitono kvietimą?

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: „Moterų laimės“ pirmasis sezonas pasakojo apie buvusią namų šeimininkę, vienišą mamą ir tris jaunas, nepatyrusias merginas, kurios ėmėsi bendro verslo ir dėl to nuolat kovojo su gyvenimo negandomis. Šią vasarą „Moterų laimės“ pagrindinė istorija suksis apie vieną heroję – aštuoniolikmetę Mildą, užaugusią vaikų namuose ir netikėtai atsidūrusią sostinėje. Milda – drąsi, nebijanti pakovoti už save, tačiau gyvenimas Vilniuje bus visai ne toks, kokio ji tikėjosi. Čia jos lauks susitikimas su biologine mama, nelegalus darbas... Herojė ne savo noru įsivels į kriminalinę veiklą, o šis jos biografijos šešėlis tikrai nepadės ateityje – nei karjeroje, nei meilėje. Į šią istoriją įsivels ne tik jaunas perspektyvus verslininkas, bet ir pagiežingas, herojei į tėvus tinkantis vyras. Tiesa, jų tikslai bus labai skirtingi...

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.
